headline: Review Peak Season Parking Policies and Memorial Hours
reservation: Mount Rushmore National Memorial does not require an entry permit, but a parking fee is mandatory for all vehicles. While reservations are not currently used for general entry, specific cave tours at nearby Wind Cave and Jewel Cave are high-bottleneck activities that require booking weeks in advance via the official portal. Always verify current parking system status and evening ceremony schedules on the official NPS site before travel.

days.title: Granite Peaks and Ponderosa Pines

stops.name: Grand View Terrace
stops.detail: Begin at the main viewing area to see the scale of the sculpture and visit the Lincoln Borglum Visitor Center.

stops.name: Presidential Trail
stops.detail: Walk the loop for different angles of the carving, noting that the path involves significant stairs.

days.driving: Allow 1 hour for local memorial access; mountain conditions vary.
days.note: Early arrival is suggested to secure parking before peak mid-day crowds.

days.title: Iron Mountain and Custer Wildlife

stops.name: Iron Mountain Road
stops.detail: Drive this scenic route known for its pigtail bridges and tunnels that frame the memorial in the distance.

stops.name: Wildlife Loop Road
stops.detail: Navigate the Custer State Park grasslands to look for bison herds and pronghorn.

days.driving: Allow 3 to 4 hours for the full scenic loop; conditions vary.
days.note: Bison are unpredictable; maintain a safe distance and stay in your vehicle.

days.title: Alpine Lakes and High Spires

stops.name: Sylvan Lake
stops.detail: Explore the shoreline of this iconic Black Hills lake surrounded by dramatic rock formations.

stops.name: Needles Highway
stops.detail: Drive past the Cathedral Spires and through narrow tunnels carved directly into granite fins.

days.driving: Allow 2 hours for narrow winding roads; conditions vary.
days.note: Check vehicle height and width clearances for the Needles Eye Tunnel before driving.

intel.title: Memorial Parking Fees
intel.text: The parking fee at Mount Rushmore is valid for one year from the date of purchase. Payment is handled at the memorial entrance kiosks; ensure you keep your receipt for re-entry.

intel.title: Canyon Connectivity
intel.text: Cellular service is often reliable near Keystone but drops significantly on Iron Mountain Road. Download offline maps for navigation between Custer and Hill City.

intel.title: Gateway Supplies
intel.text: Full service stations are concentrated in Keystone and Hill City. Ensure you have adequate fuel before entering the interior scenic roads of Custer State Park.

intel.title: Evening Lighting
intel.text: The lighting ceremony schedule changes seasonally from late spring through early fall. Check the official NPS calendar for the exact start time during your visit month.

intel.title: Winter Road Closures
intel.text: Needles Highway and Iron Mountain Road typically close for the winter season. Access to the main memorial remains open, but trails may be icy.

plan.arrival: Pick up your rental at Rapid City Regional (RAP), secure groceries in Rapid City, and proceed to your gateway base in Keystone or Hill City.
plan.vehicle: A standard car is suitable for most roads; however, large RVs are restricted on Needles Highway and Iron Mountain Road due to tunnel dimensions.
plan.goldenHour: Norbeck Overlook for sunset views across the Black Hills; visibility depends on seasonal haze.
